derivation_status: motivated after the frozen 54-setting grid rejected the handling-only H4 predictor; validation uses previously unused seeds and a full factorial intervention rather than selected positive settings

analytic_rationale.functional_anova: For independent centered state X and community coordinate Z, C is generated by variation in the X-averaged response and I by X-dependent departures from that average. In a local expansion, pure community derivatives (f_z, f_zz, ...) feed C whereas mixed derivatives (f_xz, f_xzz, ...) feed I.
analytic_rationale.exact_components: C=b^2 tau + b d mu3 + (d^2/4) Var(Z^2); I=Var(X)[c^2 tau + c e mu3 + (e^2/4) Var(Z^2)]
analytic_rationale.symmetric_case: When mu3=0 and tau is fixed by k_eff, changing the fourth cumulant changes I/C unless e^2 b^2 = c^2 d^2. The sign of d(I/C)/d Var(Z^2) is the sign of e^2 b^2-c^2 d^2.
analytic_rationale.feedback_link: In the adaptive consumer-resource model, x_{t+1}=x_t+alpha(target(x_t,Z)-x_t). For alpha>0, the chain rule adds state-by-community feedback contributions to mixed response derivatives. Setting alpha=0 removes those adjustment-generated mixed terms while leaving Gaussian matching and Holling-II saturation in place.

seed_collision_check: No repository code/file indexed on main contained any of the six seeds before this freeze.
primary_outcome: C/I order reversal indicator per block x seed: C>I at k=1 and I>C at any later k
primary_prediction: The alpha=0.15 condition will produce more C/I reversals than alpha=0 across the 108 paired block-seed comparisons.
primary_decision_rule: support if total paired difference sum(indicator_alpha015-indicator_alpha0)>0 and positive pairs outnumber negative pairs; otherwise not supported
secondary_outcomes: change in I/C from k=1 to max_{k>1} I/C
claim_boundary: This is a fresh-seed synthetic validation of a mechanism prediction, not an empirical ecological prevalence estimate.
The predictor was revised only after the handling-only prediction was falsified; that failed prediction remains part of the audit trail.
No parameter block is selected based on prior positivity: all 18 combinations of resource count, width and handling are included at both alpha levels.
No retuning after fresh-seed outcomes are opened.
